# Train Travel Calculation

## Setting Up the Problem

**Given information:**
- Speed: 60 kilometres per hour (60 km/h)
- Time duration: 2.5 hours (2½ hours, or 2 hours 30 minutes)
- Unknown quantity: **Distance travelled** (in kilometres, km)

## Understanding the Relationship

The fundamental relationship between these three quantities is:

$$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time elapsed}$$
